mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_requests (transaction_id, status, expired_at) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{status}, #{expiredAt})
mapper.sql: ar.approval_id, ar.transaction_id, ar.requested_at, ar.expired_at, senior.user_id AS ward_id, senior.name AS ward_name, t.type, t.amount, t.memo, r.holder_name, b.bank_name, r.account_no, re.risk_level, re.total_score

FROM approval_requests ar JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = ar.transaction_id JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id JOIN users senior ON senior.user_id = w.user_id JOIN guard_senior gs ON gs.senior_id = senior.user_id AND gs.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN recipients r ON r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id LEFT JOIN banks b ON b.bank_code = r.bank_code LEFT JOIN risk_evaluations re ON re.transaction_id = t.transaction_id

FROM approval_requests ar JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = ar.transaction_id JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id JOIN users senior ON senior.user_id = w.user_id LEFT JOIN recipients r ON r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id LEFT JOIN banks b ON b.bank_code = r.bank_code LEFT JOIN risk_evaluations re ON re.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE w.user_id = #{wardId} AND t.type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND ar.status = 'PENDING' AND ar.expired_at > NOW() ORDER BY ar.expired_at ASC

SELECT ar.transaction_id FROM approval_requests ar JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = ar.transaction_id JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id JOIN users senior ON senior.user_id = w.user_id JOIN guard_senior gs ON gs.senior_id = senior.user_id AND gs.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ar.approval_id = #{approvalId} AND gs.guard_id = #{guardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_requests SET status = #{status}, responded_by = #{guardId}, responded_at = #{respondedAt} WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expired_at > NOW()
UPDATE approval_requests SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expired_at <= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT rr.rule_code, rr.description FROM risk_evaluations re JOIN risk_evaluation_details red ON red.evaluation_id = re.evaluation_id JOIN risk_rules rr ON rr.rule_id = red.rule_id WHERE re.transaction_id = #{transactionId} ORDER BY red.score DESC, rr.rule_code
